en.headline: Light Rail rides free all day on Mid-Autumn Festival
en.dek: MTR said every Light Rail trip from first train to 11.59pm on Friday will carry no fare, covering Tuen Mun, Yuen Long and Tin Shui Wai.
body: The MTR Corporation will waive Light Rail fares for the whole of Mid-Autumn Festival on Friday, 25 September, from the first train until 11.59pm, timed by the clock at the entry validator.

Passengers without an Octopus card may board without buying a ticket. Those who do carry an Octopus should tap in and out as usual; the system will not deduct a Light Rail fare. The concession cannot be combined with other offers unless stated, and MTR Points will not apply during the free window.

Octopus users who chain an MTR Bus, then Light Rail, then another MTR Bus during the free period will not receive the usual interchange rebate automatically. The operator said they may claim back the last bus fare on or before 1 October at Light Rail customer service centres or at the centres inside Tuen Mun, Siu Hong, Tin Shui Wai, Long Ping and Yuen Long stations. Other interchange concessions remain unchanged.

The sixth Huatai Light Rail Ding Ding Fun day is organised with the Strive and Rise Programme. Light Rail serves the north-west New Territories districts that also host Mid-Autumn street markets and lantern displays. MTR said it may change or end the offer at any time.

zh.headline: 中秋正日輕鐵全日免費 屯元天任搭至深夜
zh.dek: 港鐵公布周五9月25日由頭班車起至晚上11時59分，進出輕鐵站無需支付車費。
body: 港鐵公布，中秋節正日（9月25日）輕鐵全日免費乘車，由頭班車起生效至晚上11時59分止，以入站顯示時間為準，覆蓋屯門、元朗及天水圍沿線。
沒有八達通的乘客可無需購票直接乘搭；持八達通者須如常拍卡出入，系統不會扣除輕鐵車資。除特別註明外，優惠不可與其他優惠同時使用，期間亦不適用MTR分獎賞。
使用八達通的乘客若在免費時段以港鐵巴士接駁輕鐵再接駁港鐵巴士，轉乘優惠未能自動套用。港鐵表示，乘客可於10月1日或之前到各輕鐵客務中心，或屯門、兆康、天水圍、朗屏及元朗站內客務中心，申請退回最後一程巴士車費。其餘轉乘優惠維持不變。
活動為第六屆「華泰輕鐵叮叮樂」，由華泰國際聯同「共創明Teen計劃」舉辦。輕鐵沿線正值中秋街市及賞燈時段。港鐵保留隨時更改或終止優惠的權利。
